name: Grace
text: I have been feeling overwhelmed with university exams and family responsibilities. I could really use some encouragement and peace right now.

name: Anonymous
text: Please pray for me as I make an important career decision this week. I want to trust God instead of being paralyzed by anxiety and fear of failure.

name: Daniel
text: Going through a difficult season of loss, but I am trying to remember that I am not walking through the valley alone. Grateful for this space.
